## Expected and observed behavior / 기대·실제 동작

Describe the specific mismatch, including the exit code and report or error text.

## Minimal reproduction / 최소 재현

Provide a small synthetic input, its contract, and the exact command.
Include complete text fixtures so another contributor can run them offline.

## Environment / 실행 환경

Python version, operating system, and the commit or release tested:

## Existing work / 관련 작업

Link any related issue or pull request. If you tested a branch with pending
changes, identify that branch.
